deal_notes: Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Primary feature: in-app assistant + contextual doc search across product docs and release notes.
Workload: embeddings index (~50M tokens corpus), re-ranking for search results, and chat assistant for end-users.
Targets: chat p50 < 150ms, throughput 20-30 reqs/sec during peak, cost sensitivity high (target ARR op_ex <$10k/mo for inference).
Model prefs: open models acceptable (gpt-like open variants); prefer quantized variants for Dedicated. Want ability to route to cheaper model variants during high load.
Security: require SSO/SAML, SOC2 evidence, audit logs, customer-managed KMS, and EU data residency for some customers.
POC notes: running Hosted API POC. SE proposed caching layer for common prefixes and batch embedding ingestion to reduce token spend. Team asked for quantization profile examples + benchmarks.
Quote from CTO: 'We care equally about latency and predictable inference spend — if Dedicated can hit our unit-economics target we'll move fast.'
Procurement: finance wants committed pricing for Q2 pilot if cost improvements shown in workshop. Legal asked for list of subprocessors and data residency SLA.
poC_details: POC type: Hosted API pilot -> potential Dedicated pilot
Success criteria: p50 chat <150ms; embedding recall @10 improves search NDCG >15% vs baseline; inference costs reduced >=30% after optimizations
Experiments planned: batching strategies, prefix/KV caching, quantization (8-bit/4-bit) + throughput benchmarks, model routing to cheaper variants
Metrics tracked: tokens/day, tokens per session, p50/p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, embedding ingestion throughput
